description: This file implements a driver for SAP SQL Anywhere (formerly Sybase SQL Anywhere) within the ADOdb database abstraction layer for PHP. It defines classes and methods for handling database interactions such as creating and dropping blob variables, loading blobs from files or variables, and updating blobs in the database.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlanywhere
classes.description: A database driver class for SAP SQL Anywhere, extending the ODBC driver with methods for blob handling and identity retrieval.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_sqlanywhere
classes.description: A record set class specific to SQL Anywhere, extending the general ODBC record set.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last insert ID for the current connection using @@identity.

methods.name: create_blobvar
methods.description: Creates a long binary variable in the database session.

methods.name: drop_blobvar
methods.description: Drops a previously created blob variable.

methods.name: load_blobvar_from_file
methods.description: Loads blob data from a file into a blob variable in chunks, converting binary data to hex string representation.

methods.name: load_blobvar_from_var
methods.description: Loads blob data from a string variable into a blob variable in chunks, converting to hex string.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob column in a table by loading the blob data into a variable and executing an update statement.
